name: GRAVBALL CONTINENTAL: Corporate Premier Division
description: The corporate successor to the independent municipal GRAVBALL leagues, the Continental Premier Division introduced mandatory augmentation tiers and sold team naming rights to corponation subsidiaries. Competitors use grav-harness implants and chrome-reinforced limbs to play a three-dimensional ball sport across a 200-meter vertical arena suspended between Tier 3 and Tier 4 architecture. The sport's beauty is undeniable — but municipal league veterans call it a hostile acquisition of something that once belonged to everyone.
story_hooks: A beloved municipal-league player who refused corporate recruitment is found dead beneath a Continental arena three days before the championship — ruled an accident.
A Tier 2 underground network is pirating and rebroadcasting Continental matches with unauthorized commentary that is somehow more accurate than the official feed.
A young the Gray Zone athlete with illegal grav-harness augmentations is scouted by a Continental team — but the contract has clauses she cannot legally parse without a corporate attorney.
